snippet.title: Indian Summer Trailer
snippet.description:
Indian Summer is the second part of Uwe Rosenberg''s puzzle trilogy following 2016's smash hit game, Cottage Garden. This game is further geared towards more experienced players. The digital adaption is brought to you by DIGIDICED.

iOS store: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/indian-summer-game/id1410742147
Android store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.digidiced.insrelease
Steam store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/900380/Indian_Summer/
